title: SentryBench: A Cost-Sensitive Benchmark for Adversarial Robustness of Tool-Using LLM Agents in Public-Safety Deployments
abstract: arXiv:2610.34535v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly wired to consequential tools that send public alerts, dispatch responders, and query citizen records, where one erroneous tool call carries real-world cost. Existing agent-safety benchmarks measure generic harm or prompt-injection success and implicitly treat refusing as the safe default. In public-safety deployments that assumption breaks: an agent too cautious to dispatch help fails as surely as one that triggers a false alert. We present SentryBench, which scores agents on a two-sided, cost-sensitive frontier jointly measuring attack success, over-refusal (missing a real emergency), and over-reaction (unwarranted action) under adversarial tool use, with scenarios grounded in real emergency-call transcripts, disaster messages, and real injection/jailbreak payloads. We formalize deployment harm as an asymmetric cost functional, prove naive caution is harm-dominated whenever it refuses

translated_title: SentryBench：面向公共安全部署中工具使用型LLM智能体对抗鲁棒性的代价敏感基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被接入具有重大影响的工具，这些工具可以发送公共警报、派遣救援人员、查询公民记录，在这种场景下一次错误的工具调用会带来现实世界的代价。现有的智能体安全基准衡量的是一般性危害或提示注入成功率，并隐含地将“拒绝”视为安全的默认选择。在公共安全部署中，这一假设不再成立：一个因过度谨慎而不派遣救援的智能体，与一个触发虚假警报的智能体同样失败。我们提出了SentryBench，它在双向、代价敏感的前沿上对智能体进行评分，在对抗性工具使用下联合衡量攻击成功率、过度拒绝（遗漏真实紧急情况）和过度反应（无正当理由的行动），其场景基于真实的紧急呼叫记录、灾害消息以及真实的注入/越狱攻击载荷。我们将部署危害形式化为一个非对称代价泛函，并证明当朴素谨慎策略拒绝时其危害总是被支配的。
tldr: 提出了SentryBench——首个面向公共安全部署的双向代价敏感基准，通过非对称代价泛函联合评估工具使用型LLM智能体在对抗性工具调用下的攻击成功率、过度拒绝与过度反应，揭示单纯求安全的拒绝策略并不总是最优。
en_tdlr: SentryBench is a two-sided, cost-sensitive benchmark that jointly measures attack success, over-refusal, and over-reaction of tool-using LLM agents under adversarial tool use in public-safety deployments, formalizing deployment harm as an asymmetric cost functional showing that naive caution is not always the safe choice.
